coverage_geometry: cell62 original mask and aperture; other44 have conditional plugin diagnostics
intervals: normal interval using plugin parametric Poisson bootstrap SD; lower endpoint max(0,lower); not a Hessian error
coverage_acceptance: failure_rate<=0.01 and coverage>=nominal-0.03-3*sqrt(nominal*(1-nominal)/256), both 68% and 95%, all8scenarios; failures included in denominator
bias_acceptance: abs(bias)/true_B_on<=0.10 in every independent truth scenario; no bias correction selected after results
spectral_design: independent Poisson ON with frozen folded truth+plugin background; independent cell bootstrap B estimates; 256 samples, fit both models with legacy and propagated errors; conditional on observed bootstrap variances, not a full nested calibration of all44
scientific_acceptance: data+numerics+positive finite B_on+all independent truth coverage/bias gates; fit quality separately requires valid PL/LogPar and preferred p>=0.01; spectral intervals remain conditional diagnostic
limits: finite truth families do not prove universal unbiasedness
SED shape frozen as legacy; shape uncertainty assessed by conditional spectral ensemble only
